title: CLI and Developer Tools
summary: This module offers a comprehensive suite of command-line tools for managing CrewAI projects, including commands for checkpoints, deployments, tools, and configurations. It also provides developer utilities for versioning, releasing, and automating documentation, streamlining both user interaction and development workflows.
